scripts.build: npm run build -w @instadescribe/sdk && npm run build -w instadescribe
scripts.codegen: npm run openapi:export && npm run openapi:project && npm run codegen -w @instadescribe/sdk
scripts.codegen:check: python3 services/api/scripts/export_openapi.py --check && npm run openapi:check -w @instadescribe/sdk && npm run codegen -w @instadescribe/sdk && git diff --exit-code -- openapi packages/sdk/src/generated packages/sdk/openapi/instadescribe-integration-v1.contract.json
scripts.package:check: publint packages/sdk && publint packages/cli && attw --pack packages/sdk --profile esm-only && attw --pack packages/cli --profile esm-only
scripts.test: npm run test -w @instadescribe/sdk && npm run test -w instadescribe
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @instadescribe/sdk && npm run typecheck -w instadescribe
